responsibility: This file declares the PRU-specific command-line options and their binding to backend state. It defines target flags and joined options such as -mloop, -mno-relax, -mmcu=, -minrt, and -mabi=, including the enum mapping for ABI selection through pru_current_abi, so GCC can generate option tables and expose PRU code-generation controls to the driver and backend.
same_name_distinction: Option-definition file for the PRU backend: unlike pru.cc implementation code, pru.h target configuration macros, and pru.md instruction patterns, this file exists to declare PRU-specific -m switches and ABI enums so GCC can generate option parsing tables and bind them to backend state such as pru_current_abi and OPT_LOOP.
